breakdown.description: The specified outer-boundary point load is replaced by a distributed end traction
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Apply an additional concentrated downward load of -5000 N at point (1.0, 0.25) using PointSource on the vertical displacement component' and 'Do not replace the point load with a uniform traction on the right edge.' This correctly resolves the inconsistency by using a PointSource (as specified in the ground truth) rather than smearing the load as a distributed end traction over the right edge (as incorrectly specified in the incomplete prompt).
